description: This script processes JUnit test report files, parsing XML reports to extract test case information and rendering test results with colorized output. It supports both single files and directories containing multiple XML reports.

methods.name: list[TestCase] parse_junit_reports(path_to_reports: str)
methods.description: Parses JUnit XML report files from a specified path, returning a list of test cases.

methods.name: list[TestCase] convert_junit_to_testcases(xml: JUnitXml | TestSuite)
methods.description: Converts a JUnitXml or TestSuite object into a list of individual TestCase objects.

methods.name: None render_tests(testcases: list[TestCase])
methods.description: Displays test case results with color-coded output, indicating passed, failed, and skipped tests.

methods.name: Any parse_args()
methods.description: Parses command-line arguments to obtain the report path.

methods.name: None main()
methods.description: Main execution function that orchestrates the parsing and rendering of test reports.
